title: limit branded terms
rule: Limit branded terms in command text (application name on the app menu and Help is enough); other commands stay nonbranded.
pass_when: App name appears on the app menu and Help as needed; other command text is nonbranded.
fail_when: Brand/product name stuffed into ordinary command labels.
overview: Brand names stay limited in command text; ordinary commands stay nonbranded.
apply_when: Writing everyday command labels outside the app menu and Help.
not_when: App menu or Help entries that appropriately include the product name.
agent_hint: Keep brand out of ordinary commands; app menu and Help may name the app.
description: Limit branded terms in command text so labels stay scannable and focused on the action. The application name on the app menu and Help is enough; other commands should stay nonbranded. Stuffing the product name into ordinary actions adds noise without clarifying the outcome people will get. Keep brand where identity belongs; keep command verbs plain everywhere else.
